evidence.decision: Classifies the entire group as single choice, platform-supported multiple choice or momentary action and prevents mixing contracts.
evidence.artifact: Requires selection-model changes or a segment/affected-content specification with accessible state aligned to content.
evidence.transformation: Photo Grid/List/Export example keeps view selection together and moves Export into a separate action while retaining the selected view.
evidence.verification: Checks repeat activation, localization, external state changes and relevant TV focus; fails mixed semantics or indistinguishable selection.
evidence.applicability: Qualifies Mac multiple selection/pane tabs, TV focus-triggered selection, visionOS text tooltips and watch nonapplicability.
evidence.handoffs: Routes top-level sections to tab-bars, Mac panes to tab-views and independent commands to buttons.
evidence.distinctiveness: A common interaction model for every segment drives the correction, beyond a generic instruction to group related controls.
